Hon'ble Shri Justice Arvind Kumar Verma, Order on Board 08.11.2024 1.

Present is an appeal by the claimant under Section 173 of the Motor Vehicles Act assailing the award dated 18.07.2017 passed by the learned 8th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur (C.G.) in Motor Accident Claim Case No. 234/2016.
Pyarelal vs Sanat on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88071003/
1 2.

entities.text: 8th Additional Motor Accident Claims Tribunal, Raipur (C.G.)
entities.label: COURT

sentences.text: Brief facts of the case is that on 19.05.2015, the deceased Milan Nishad was pillion rider in motorcycle bearing registration No. CG- 04/AC-2509, which was being driven by respondent No. 1 rashly and negligently and due to rash and negligent driving of motorcycle by respondent No. 1, the deceased Milan Nishad pulled down from motorcycle at that time, he was quelled by unknown vehicle Bolero, due to which, the deceased Milan Nishad died on spot.

3. The respondent No. 2 filed their written statement and submitted that the driver, owner and insurer of unknown Bolero, which has quelled to the deceased, have not been made party in the claim petition, therefore on account of non-joinder of necessary party, the claim petition is not maintainable.

4. The learned Tribunal, after hearing both the parties and perusal of material available on record,
has rejected the claim application under Section 166 of the Motor Vehicles Act filed by the claimants by holding that according to FIR and criminal case record, the accident was occurred by other vehicle Bolero, therefore the claimants are not entitled to get any compensation from the Insurance Company of motorcycle.
5.

Learned counsel for the appellant submits that on the fateful day, the deceased was pillion rider in motorcycle and due to rash and negligent driving of the motorcycle by respondent No. 1, the deceased fell down from motorcycle and at that time, he was quelled by unknown Bolero vehicle,
therefore, the claim petition filed by the claimants against the insurer of motorcycle is maintainable.
6.

Learned counsel for the appellant further submits that the accident was occurred by collusion of two vehicles i.e. motorcycle and unknown Bolero, therefore the claimants can claim compensation from any Insurance Company i.e. either from insurer of motorcycle or from Bolero.

7. Learned counsel for the respondent No. 2 supports the award and submits that the learned Tribunal has rightly rejected the claim petition of the claimants, which does not require any interference by this Court.

8. Heard learned counsel for the parties, considered their rival submissions and perused the record with utmost circumspection.
9.

On perusal of records, it transpires the fact that in the present case, FIR and criminal records show that on the date of accident, the accident was occurred by unknown offending vehicle Bolero and the driver of the unknown Bolero Vehicle was being driven in a rash and negligent manner and due to which accident took place and Milan Nishad had died.

However, before the learned Tribunal,
the claimants were trying to put different story that on the date of accident, the Milan Nishad was pillion rider in motorcycle bearing registration No. CG-04- AC-2509 which was being driven by respondent No. 1 rashly and negligently and due to rash and negligent driving of motorcycle, Milan Nishad pulled down from motorcycle at that time, he was quelled by unknown vehicle Bolero, due to which, he died on spot.

Pyarelal vs Sanat on 8 November, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/88071003/
2 10.Considering the facts of the case and also considering the FIR and criminal records of the case and also considering the observation made by the learned Tribunal, this Court is of the opinion that the learned Tribunal has rightly dismissed the claim petition of the claimants by holding that according to FIR and criminal case record, the accident was occurred by other vehicle Bolero and the claimants are not entitled to get any compensation from the Insurance Company of Motorcycle.
